title: Battery Expiration Check Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Go-bag inventories (`gobag:inventory`), prep drills (`prep:drill`), water rotation logs (`water:rotation`), battery expiration checks (`battery:expiration`), and radio tests (`radio:test`).
app: Go-bag inventory audits, household prep drill logs, water rotation schedules, battery expiration trackers, and emergency radio test results streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=battery:expiration
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by device_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>720
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when battery expiration check data has stopped arriving for a given device.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per device and alert when the feed is older than 720 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers when one part of your battery expiration check feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
